name: flowkeeper
description: FlowKeeper plugins for Claude Cowork and Claude Code.

plugins.name: fk-po
plugins.description: Product-owner tooling — four skills. The explore → brainstorm → ticket flow: fk-po-explore (read-only feature explainer in product language), fk-po-brainstorm (pre-ticket grilling loop for fuzzy ideas), and fk-po-ticket (full grilled Jira ticket with screenshot attachments). Plus fk-release-notes: drafts EN+NL release-note items from shipped Jira tickets for the PO to review and publish manually. The ticket and brainstorm flows grow CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/ in both repos inline.
